breakingChanges: Direct creates no replayable evidence workflow, but Git mutation requires a minimal TaskWorkspaceLeaseV1.
Mutating Git tasks default to task-owned worktrees and never modify a dirty source checkout.
Shared state defaults to a host-neutral Better Workflows root instead of CODEX_HOME; v3 state requires an explicit SBW_STATE_ROOT binding.
Workspace routing Profiles use .better-workflows/profile.json; the v3 .codex path is accepted only as a single-path fallback.
Stable tags are created only after exact-SHA website QA and authenticated Tier 1 conformance gates.
